title: Skilled Worker visa for the United Kingdom: a sponsored job in an eligible occupation, usually paying at least £41,700 a year and the going rate, with English at B2

sources.title: Immigration Rules, Appendix Skilled Worker, SW 1.3: the applicant must be aged 18 or over on the date of application
Appendix Skilled Worker, SW 3.3: a person must not be applying for entry clearance as a Skilled Worker as a national or citizen of Afghanistan
Explanatory memorandum to Statement of Changes HC 1691, para. 5.3: Skilled Worker visa applications from main applicants who are nationals of Afghanistan are refused from 26 March 2026
Appendix Skilled Worker, SW 5.1 to 5.3: a valid Certificate of Sponsorship for the job, from an authorised sponsor, A-rated unless the worker stays with the sponsor of their last permission
Appendix Skilled Worker, SW 4.2 and the table after SW 4.4, option A: a salary of at least £41,700 per year and the going rate for the SOC 2020 occupation code
Immigration Rules, Appendix Skilled Occupations, Tables 1 to 3: the eligible occupations, skilled to RQF level 6 or above, and their going rates
Appendix Skilled Worker, SW 6.1, 6.1A and 6.1B: an eligible occupation in Table 1, 2 or 3, the Immigration Salary List or the Temporary Shortage List; care workers only switching inside the UK
Appendix Skilled Worker, table after SW 4.4, options B and C: a relevant PhD with £37,500 and 90% of the going rate; a STEM PhD with £33,400 and 80% of the going rate
Appendix Skilled Worker, table after SW 4.4, options D and E: a job on the Immigration Salary List with £33,400 and the going rate; a new entrant with £33,400 and 70% of the going rate
Appendix Skilled Worker, SW 4.1 and 7.1 to 7.2: English at CEFR level B2 in reading, writing, speaking and listening, shown as Appendix English Language specifies
Appendix English Language, EL 4.1, EL 5.1 and EL 6.1: a national of a majority-English-speaking country, an academic qualification taught in English, or an approved English language test
Explanatory memorandum to Statement of Changes HC 1333, paras. 5.22, 5.23 and 6.4: the Skilled Worker English requirement rises from B1 to B2 for first grants from 8 January 2026
Appendix Skilled Worker, SW 15.1 to 15.3: £1,270 held for 28 days, unless the A-rated sponsor certifies maintenance or the worker applies inside the UK after 12 months there with permission
Appendix Skilled Worker, SW 26.3, 29.1, 29.1A, 29.2 and 32A.1 to 32A.2: a dependent partner aged 18 or over and dependent children of a Skilled Worker sponsored for a job in Table 1, 2 or 3
Appendix Skilled Worker, SW 33.1, 33.3 and 33.5: £285 for a partner, £315 for the first child, £200 for any other, held for 28 days, unless applying inside the UK after 12 months there
Appendix Skilled Worker, SW 29.1A and 32A.2: a partner or child joins only a Skilled Worker sponsored for a job in Table 1, Table 2 or Table 3 of Appendix Skilled Occupations, save listed exceptions
Appendix Skilled Worker, SW 18.1: permission until 14 days after the end date of the certificate of sponsorship, which may be up to 5 years after its start date
Home Office immigration and nationality fees, 8 October 2026: Skilled Worker per person, £819 or £1,618 from outside the UK and £943 or £1,865 inside it; Health and Care Visa £324 or £628
Pay for UK healthcare as part of your immigration application, how much you pay: £1,035 per year, or £776 per year for applicants under the age of 18 at the time of application
Appendix Relationship with Partner, RWP 1.1 and 5.1: both partners 18 or over; if not married or civil partners, a relationship similar to marriage for at least 2 years
Appendix Children, CHI 1.1, 1.2, 1A.1 and 3.2: under 18, or older after permission as a dependent child; no partner, living with a parent; both parents come unless one has sole responsibility
Immigration Rules, introduction, para. 5C and definitions: not for Irish citizens who need no leave; a partner is a spouse, civil or unmarried partner of 2 years; a parent is not a step-parent
Immigration Act 1971, s. 2(1)(a): a person has the right of abode in the United Kingdom if they are a British citizen
Immigration Act 1971, s. 3ZA(1): an Irish citizen does not require leave to enter or remain in the United Kingdom
Appendix Skilled Worker, SW 4.2(b) and (c) and options F to K: a Health and Care ASHE salary job or earlier Skilled Worker from £25,000 to £31,300; a Table 3 health or education job £25,000
Appendix Skilled Worker, SW 3.2 and 28.2: from abroad, the worker, partner and child give a TB certificate if Appendix Tuberculosis applies
Appendix Tuberculosis, TB1, TB2 and TB6: a TB certificate for entry clearance of over 6 months after 6 months or more in a listed country
Appendix Skilled Worker, SW 16.1, 16.2, 34.1 and 34.2: a criminal record certificate for a job in a listed occupation code, for the worker and the partner, from abroad
Appendix Skilled Worker, SW 6.3A: a valid ATAS certificate if the ATAS requirement in Appendix ATAS applies
Appendix ATAS: a certificate for the Skilled Worker route to work as a researcher in a specified subject
Pay for UK healthcare as part of your immigration application, who needs to pay: not a health and care worker eligible for a Health and Care Worker visa, or their dependant

requirements.title: Not a British or Irish citizen: they live and work in the UK without a visa
Not applying from abroad as a citizen of Afghanistan (refused since 26 March 2026); a dual national, or someone switching from another permission inside the UK: possible

assessments.title: A Certificate of Sponsorship for the job from a licensed employer, A-rated unless the worker stays with the sponsor of their last Skilled Worker permission
An eligible occupation: Table 1, 2 or 3 of Appendix Skilled Occupations (1a, 2aa, 3a in some cases), Immigration Salary List or Temporary Shortage List (issued before 31 Dec 2026); care: SW 6.1B
A salary of at least £41,700 a year and the going rate for the occupation (option A)
Or, with a PhD relevant to the job, £37,500 a year and 90% of the going rate; with a STEM PhD, £33,400 and 80% of the going rate
Or, for a job on the Immigration Salary List, £33,400 a year and the going rate; for a new entrant at the start of their career, £33,400 and 70% of the going rate
Or, for a Table 3 health or education job, £25,000 and the going rate; for a Health and Care ASHE salary job, or a Skilled Worker since before 4 April 2024 until 4 April 2030, £25,000 to £31,300
English at level B2 in reading, writing, speaking and listening (B1 if the last Skilled Worker permission required B1), shown in a way Appendix English Language allows
Savings of £1,270 held for 28 days by the worker, unless the A-rated sponsor certifies it will maintain them, or they apply inside the UK after 12 months there with permission
Plus £285 for a partner, £315 for the first child and £200 for each other child, held for 28 days, unless the sponsor certifies it will maintain them or they apply inside the UK after 12 months there
From abroad, a TB test certificate for the worker and each partner or child who has been 6 months or more continuously in a country Appendix Tuberculosis lists, part of it in the last 6 months
From abroad, for a job SW 16.1 lists (mostly health, education, care): a criminal record certificate from each country lived in 12 months or more in the last 10 years since 18, for worker and partner
An ATAS certificate for a researcher in a sensitive subject, where Appendix ATAS requires one

dependents.title: Spouse aged 18 or over; only if the worker's job is in Table 1, 2 or 3 (not checked)
Partner aged 18 or over, after 2 years in a relationship similar to marriage; a shorter one, which may be a civil partnership: possible; job in Table 1, 2 or 3 (not checked)
Children under 18 with no spouse; with a partner: possible (not after 2 years); living with the principal, other parent coming not checked; adult child: possible; job in Table 1, 2 or 3 (not checked)

costs.title: Visa fee from abroad, certificate of three years or less: £819 for the main applicant (Immigration Salary List: £628; Health and Care Visa: £324); one of several alternatives: possible
Visa fee in the UK, certificate of three years or less: £943 for the main applicant (Immigration Salary List: £628; Health and Care Visa: £324); one of several alternatives: possible
Visa fee from abroad, certificate of three years or less: £819 for each partner or child (Immigration Salary List: £628; Health and Care Visa: £324); one of several alternatives: possible
Visa fee in the UK, certificate of three years or less: £943 for each partner or child (Immigration Salary List: £628; Health and Care Visa: £324); one of several alternatives: possible
Visa fee from abroad, certificate of over three years: £1,618 for the main applicant (Immigration Salary List: £1,235; Health and Care Visa: £628); one of several alternatives: possible
Visa fee in the UK, certificate of over three years: £1,865 for the main applicant (Immigration Salary List: £1,235; Health and Care Visa: £628); one of several alternatives: possible
Visa fee from abroad, certificate of over three years: £1,618 for each partner or child (Immigration Salary List: £1,235; Health and Care Visa: £628); one of several alternatives: possible
Visa fee in the UK, certificate of over three years: £1,865 for each partner or child (Immigration Salary List: £1,235; Health and Care Visa: £628); one of several alternatives: possible
Immigration health surcharge, £1,035 a year, shown for the 5 years of a five-year certificate (£5,175; the 14 days after it may add half a year); none for a Health and Care Worker visa: possible

Health surcharge of each partner or child aged 18 or over, £1,035 a year for the 5 years of a five-year certificate (£5,175, or more for the 14 days after it); none on a Health and Care visa: possible
Health surcharge of each child under 18, £776 a year for the 5 years of a five-year certificate (£3,880, or more for the 14 days after it); none on a Health and Care Worker visa: possible

durations.title: Permission until 14 days after the end date of the certificate of sponsorship, which is at most 5 years after its start date
